cmapss_fd001_rul.model: RULPredictor(window_size=30, rul_cap=125, backend=optuna, n_trials=30, stride=5, drop_constant_sensors=True)

hdfail_survival.dataset: Backblaze Hard Drive Failure (hdfail, 52K drives, 5 features)
hdfail_survival.note: Replaces saturated NASA Battery benchmark. 94% censoring, 5.5% failure rate. Source: frailtySurv R package (Backblaze Drive Stats). Published SOTA C=0.958 with 21 SMART features (Ahmed & Green, 2024).

smap_anomaly_detection.note: Gated on threshold-independent ROC AUC (random = 0.5). Point-adjust F1 is not used as the gate: a random detector at the same 17% alert rate scores PA-F1=0.631 vs 0.638 for this model. Score version 2 (block-wise SR, orthonormal IFFT, relative spectral floor); threshold from normal training scores only, test labels evaluation-only. Canonical run also reports PA-F1=0.6378, precision=0.4702, recall=0.9910, AP=0.1613 (prevalence 0.128). Superseded baselines: PA-F1=0.9667 (test-label threshold leak) and PA-F1=0.4355 (v1 scoring, only 28 test points could cross the threshold).
